name: design-agency-dashboard
description: L'interfaccia del cruscotto (ADR-0024, ADR-0033): solo lettura, legge tutto dall'API Django.

scripts.dev: env -u ANTHROPIC_API_KEY -u AGENCY_ANTHROPIC_API_KEY NEXT_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1 next dev -H 127.0.0.1 -p 3000
scripts.build: env -u ANTHROPIC_API_KEY -u AGENCY_ANTHROPIC_API_KEY NEXT_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1 next build && node scripts/standalone.mjs
scripts.start: env -u ANTHROPIC_API_KEY -u AGENCY_ANTHROPIC_API_KEY NEXT_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1 HOSTNAME=127.0.0.1 PORT=3000 node .next/standalone/server.js
scripts.typecheck: env -u ANTHROPIC_API_KEY -u AGENCY_ANTHROPIC_API_KEY NEXT_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1 next typegen && tsc --noEmit
